data.description: the resource the operation created or updated; a remove and a relationship write return no data [ext-atomic]

uiLocale.query.name: uiLocale
uiLocale.query.description: the language the client asks for, one basic language range such as uk or en-GB [primary: RFC 4647 2.1]; an empty value or one of another form gets 400. every link of the response carries it on as the request wrote it. it takes precedence over Accept-Language

Accept-Language.header.name: Accept-Language
Accept-Language.header.description: the languages the client prefers, by weight [primary: RFC 9110 12.5.4]; a malformed element is disregarded. it is read only where the request does not carry the query parameter uiLocale

Content-Language.description: the language of the representation, chosen from the language range of the query parameter uiLocale, else from the language ranges of Accept-Language [primary: RFC 9110 8.5]

Vary.description: the request fields the selected representation depends on: Accept, and Accept-Language where the request does not carry the query parameter uiLocale [primary: RFC 9110 12.5.5]

ETag.description: the entity tag of the selected representation, which a conditional write sends back in If-Match. a response to a request with include carries none, since its query selects another representation

Location.description: the self link of the resource the request created [spec, Creating Resources]

Content-Location.description: the self link of the resource that monitors the accepted write [primary: RFC 9110 15.3.3]

WWW-Authenticate.description: the authentication schemes that apply to this request, at least one of them [primary: RFC 9110 15.5.2]

Accept.description: the media types of the content the route reads, which "can be used to indicate which media types would have been accepted in the request" [primary: RFC 9110 15.5.16]

Content-Disposition.description: attachment, with the file name the client saves the content under, where the endpoint names one [primary: RFC 6266 4]

Content-Length.description: the octets of the content, where its size is known before it is sent and nothing between the site and the client changes it [primary: RFC 9110 8.6]

restNonce.name: X-WP-Nonce
restNonce.description: the nonce of the action wp_rest, read beside the logged-in cookie of the site; without it WordPress treats the request as unauthenticated

paymentSignature.name: X-Payment-Signature
paymentSignature.description: the signature the payment service computes over the body
